summary: Configured and verified a reboot-persistent three-node OpenTelemetry Collector deployment with mTLS, namespace routing, durable forwarding queues, and JSON retention.
actions_performed: Installed otelcol-contrib v0.159.0 and enabled collectors on node1, node2, and node3.
Configured node1 HTTPS OTLP/HTTP on TCP 4318 with client certificate authentication.
Configured current routing connector rules for payments → node2 and inventory → node3; unmatched namespaces are dropped.
Configured mutually authenticated TLS forwarding and destination-side namespace allowlists.
Configured persistent forwarding queues and retained files at /var/lib/otel/payments.json and /var/lib/otel/inventory.json.
Installed evaluation CA/certificate/key under /root/otel-client with client.key mode 600.
Validated configurations, TLS chains, service enablement, active listeners, queue state, and cleaned test telemetry.
